Sam's favorite animal is the panda. Eva's birthday is in May. There are always many people at the science corner. What's more, the window lets in the morning sun.
Last Thursday, Sam and Eva went to the school lab. Sam plays volleyball with Eva every Thursday. Sam thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. For example, he replies to chats with memes.
They took many photos at the science corner. The school lab is one of the best places in the city. Both of them like bread and coffee.
